titulo: Advanced Imaging in Methanol Toxicity: Bilateral Putaminal Necrosis and Frontal–Occipital Ischemia—A Case Report

fig.label: Figure 1
fig.caption: Noncontrast CT Brain (axial view) hospital Day 3 showing diffuse bilateral hypoattenuation of the putamen, external capsule, and claustrum; bilateral frontal lobe subcortical low‐attenuation areas are also shown (yellow arrows). Teaching point: These findings illustrate the evolution of methanol toxicity after an initially normal CT.
